auth.welcome: From home to school, fresh meals, brighter futures.
auth.phoneHint: We will send a 6-digit code by SMS
auth.invalidPhone: Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number

register.title: Tell us about you
register.terms: I accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy

consent.title: Parental consent
consent.intro: Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, we need your verifiable consent as the parent or lawful guardian before we store any information about your child.
consent.childData: I am the parent or lawful guardian and I consent to LunchBox processing my child's name, school, class and allergy notes only to deliver lunch.
consent.liveTracking: Show me my delivery partner's live location during an active delivery.
consent.required: Parental consent is required to add a child.

today.title: Today's lunchboxes

code.title: Pickup code
code.instructions: Hand the lunchbox only to a partner who confirms this code or scans the QR.

track.title: Live tracking
track.consentOff: Live location is off. Enable it under Account → Privacy.

children.title: Your children
children.allergies: Allergies or notes for the school (optional)
children.removeConfirm: This cancels the child's lunch plan. Continue?

address.title: Pickup addresses
address.label: Label (e.g. Home)
address.pin: Drag the map to place the pin on your door

subscribe.title: Choose a plan

calendar.title: Leave days
calendar.intro: Tap a school day to skip pickup. Changes close at the daily cut-off.
